requirements.text: We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions
BS in Computer Science or a related field
5+ years of experience building software products with a large user base
Experience with a major cloud provider (GCP and/or AWS) and relational databases
Comfort building with AI coding tools
Strong SQL and experience analyzing data: defining metrics, separating signal from noise, and explaining findings to non-technical audiences
As much interest in business and operational problems as in technical challenges, and the communication skills to work directly with senior stakeholders
A track record of owning products end to end, from ambiguous problem to shipped solution
Experience with Go, React/TypeScript, and Postgres
A background in data science or statistics (e.g., survey analysis, forecasting, or experimentation)
Experience with HR, finance, or other enterprise data systems
Experience at product companies in the HR-tech or fintech space
A history of using software to solve logistical and operational problems, such as internal tooling or process automation
A combined business and engineering background
